verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Grok is marketed as a strong coding/agentic model and can integrate with external connectors (email, files, calendar, custom APIs), but there is no documentation or community report of a built-in code-execution/data-analysis tool that runs code on uploaded data to produce charts, computed answers, or downloadable files. Missing for 10: any mention of a code interpreter/sandbox, chart generation, or file-export capability tied to running code on user data.
